name: Liquid-Crystal and Related SLMs
definition: Use of spatial light modulators (SLMs) such as LCDs or magneto-optic SLMs to modulate light with a computed holographic fringe. LCDs are common electro-optic SLMs, typically containing about one million pixels. Magneto-optic SLMs often contain less than one million elements.
summary: Liquid-Crystal and Related SLMs are electro-optic or micromechanical devices that modulate light for holography using parallel spatial modulation, avoiding the complex scanning mirrors and high-speed analog conversion required by scanned-AOM systems.
